subject: Re: Backburner: Redwood inference demo for CloudLedger

Subject: Intro + demo proposal for CloudLedger

Hi Tom / Priya,

Great connecting last week at the payments roundtable — thanks for your time. Based on our notes, I think a 30–40 minute demo of Redwood focused on inference cost controls and the Dedicated option would be most valuable for your infra and payments teams.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 12 Jul, 10:00–10:40
- Wed 13 Jul, 14:00–14:40
- Thu 14 Jul, 09:00–09:40

I attached a short agenda and an initial proposal so your procurement team can see pricing bands. If none of those work, send a couple of times that do and I’ll adapt.

Agenda (attached: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf):
- 5m intros + context
- 15m live demo (batching, KV cache, routing)
- 10m Q&A (security, SLAs)
- 5–10m next steps / mutual action plan

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

That said, we still want to see a short demo to validate fit — can we push to Thu 14 Jul at 09:00 PST? If the migration takes longer we may need to defer entirely but let’s try the 14th for now.

Tom

Hi Vanessa — quick update from our side. We’ve had two things collide: (1) several infra folks are traveling next week for a compliance audit and won’t be available for demos, and (2) leadership asked us to push non-urgent vendor evaluations to H2 while we get the billing migration stable. At this point the demo is not cancelled, but it’s fair to call it "backburnered" — we want to keep the conversation but don’t have a timeline for active evaluation.

Could you please: 1) share the short deck/recording after the scheduled slot so our folks can review asynchronously, and 2) check back with us in mid-August to see if we can re-prioritize?

Thanks for understanding.

— Priya
Priya Raman
Senior Product Manager, CloudLedger

Action items from our side:
- We will convert the planned 14 Jul demo into a short recorded walkthrough (10–12m) that highlights: Dedicated sizing, integration checklist for billing migration, and the fallback policies that avoid double-billing during migrations.
- Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf, initial-proposal-cloudledger.xlsx (pushed to the deal record).
- I’ll set a reminder to check back on the week of Aug 17 to see if you’ve reopened vendor evaluations; if you prefer a different cadence please let me know.

If helpful I can also provide a concise one-pager for your procurement team that calls out procurement lead times and standard contract windows.

We’ll mark the HubSpot deal as "Paused — customer reprioritized" but not lost; I’ll tag you on any short-form content we publish that’s relevant.

Appreciate the heads up — catch up in August.
